about_the_game:
Unravel the truth of a mesmerizing dream world in a brand-new roguelike dice-builder where fate rests in your hands...Roll the dice, shape your fate, and battle through Fudgy Dice! The adorable fusion of deckbuilders and dice games!

In this chaotic dice game, battle by throwing various dice onto the gameboard. By hitting the other dice on the board you can change their values to your advantage, as at the end of the dice-throwing phase, each die will be converted into dicepower, the resource used to power your skill-runes in dynamic battles!

Utilize various Strategies!

Debuff your opponent with banes! Overwhelm them with special abilities, or add various properties to your dice with your runes. Runes consist of battle-runes, which activate during the battle phase, and dice-runes which help enhance the power of your dice! Build a powerful grid to help you through various unique challenges!

Wander the world of dice!

You will collect various runes, dice, and relics in this mysterious world. Battle your way through powerful duelists, and find yourself in mysterious dreams as you try to reach the end! But remember, no run is the same, so failure is never the end! 

Collect dozens of unique Dice!

Collect tons of special dice, each with its unique visuals and abilities. Blow away dice with the Die-namyte, or buff them with a dice bouquet. Each of these dice can additionally be enhanced by various mysterious attributes making for endless possibilities!

Tons of special Relics

Each of these relics adds a major or minor passive effect or ability to your character! But remember, you can only equip so many at a time, so you'll have to make some major strategic decisions!

Meet various new friends!

As you venture through the world of dice, you will learn about its origins and the various characters that call it home. In a story full of mystery, comedic moments, and sorrow, who will end up on top?

  • A cast of more than 5 colorful playable characters each with unique special skills, runes, dice, and strategies!

  • A cute and colorful pixel art style.

  • A wonderful soundtrack full of dreamy and high-energy songs!

  • Infinitely replayable roguelike gameplay!

  • Lucky Clover (Lucky Clover does not endorse such blatant advertisement)
